# ui::RadialGradientBrush

Header: `winui/render/Brush.hpp`.

A radial gradient. The defaults: an ellipse centered on the box with radii of half its size, the gradient starting at the center. `gradient_origin` is a point in the same space as `center`, not an offset from it.

Example: 
```cpp
auto rect = std::make_unique<ui::RectangleControl>();
rect->set_fill(ui::RadialGradientBrush{
    .stops  = {{0.0f, ui::Color::from_rgba(255, 255, 0)}, {1.0f, ui::Color::from_rgba(0, 0, 255)}},
    .center = ui::Point{0.25f, 0.25f},
});
```

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `stops` | `GradientStops` |  | The color stops, from `gradient_origin` (offset 0) out to the ellipse's edge (offset 1). |
| `center` | `Point` | `{0.5f, 0.5f}` | Center of the outer ellipse, in the space `mapping_mode` picks. |
| `radius_x` | `float` | `0.5f` | Horizontal radius of the outer ellipse, in the space `mapping_mode` picks. |
| `radius_y` | `float` | `0.5f` | Vertical radius of the outer ellipse, in the space `mapping_mode` picks. |
| `gradient_origin` | `Point` | `{0.5f, 0.5f}` | Where offset 0 sits; moving it off `center` gives an off-center highlight. |
| `mapping_mode` | `BrushMappingMode` | `BrushMappingMode::RelativeToBoundingBox` | Whether the points and radii above are box fractions or DIPs. |
| `spread_method` | `GradientSpreadMethod` | `GradientSpreadMethod::Pad` | What is painted outside the outer ellipse. |
